results.title: Ghana World Cup 2026: Fixtures, manager, squad depth and tactical analysis
highlights:
Carlos Queiroz has a good range of options in what is a fairly deep squad, with some talented young stars potentially missing out on his starting eleven this summer. Jordan Ayew will likely start as the central striker, with Antoine Semenyo and Abdul Fatawu set to take up the wide spots either side of him.
[...]
In midfield, Thomas Partey and Elisha Owusu provide a sturdy base. Monaco defender Mohammed Salisu misses out through injury so Jerome Opoku and Jonas Adjetey could be the first-choice defenders ahead of Lawrence Ati-Zigi between the sticks.
